title: Emerald Escape | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Home Located Just 200 Feet From Beach– Gulf Views & Access To Community Pool- Emerald Escape by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Emerald Escape by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 96 Majestica Circle, Santa Rosa Beach Details: Just 200 feet from a private community beach access, Emerald Escape in the gated Majestica Beach community south of 30A offers an ideal coastal retreat. Guests enjoy a community pool just steps away, three spacious porches for relaxing, and two complimentary beach sets featuring two umbrellas and four chairs for easy days on the sand. The home also includes six adult bikes, beach towel service, and thoughtfully designed living spaces throughout. Sleeping up to 14 guests, it features five bedrooms and five full baths, including a first-floor queen guest room, a second-floor king suite paired with an open-concept great room and chef’s kitchen, and a third floor with two king suites, a kids’ bunk room, and a convenient morning kitchen. With luxury finishes, plenty of space, and prime access to the sugar-white beaches of 30A, Emerald Escape is made for unforgettable beach vacations. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Distance to Beach Access: 200 Feet (1 Minute Walk); Private Community Beach Access - Private, Gated Community Located South of 30A - Community Pool Steps Away - 2 Complimentary Beach Sets With 2 Umbrellas and 4 Chairs (Available March-October) - 6 Adult Bikes - Beach Towel Service - 3 Spacious Porches - Smart TV Provided In Bedrooms and Smart TV in Living Area Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 14 5 Bedrooms / 5 Full Baths First Floor: - Guest Room 1: Queen Bed, Private Bath with Shower/Tub Combo, Double Vanity, TV -Laundry Second Floor: - Guest Room 2: King Bed, Private Bath with Shower, Double Vanity, TV - Great Room / Dining Room / Kitchen / Large Porch / Additional Full Bath Third Floor: - Guest Room 3: King Bed, Private Bath with Shower, Double Vanity, TV, Porch with Outdoor Seating - Guest Room 4: King Bed, Private Bath with Shower, Double Vanity, TV, Balcony - Guest Room 5: Bunk Room (Twin/Full/Twin Trundle/Full Futon) - Morning Kitchen Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
